title: K082220: SOMATOM P47 (SOMATOM Definition Flash), 510(k) summary and clearance letter
lineage: Applicant summary and regulator clearance letter. The 2008 filing calls the device P47; K133589 explicitly identifies K082220 as the Definition Flash clearance.

passages.note: Names SOMATOM Definition K052216 and Definition AS/AS+ K081022 as predicates and describes P47 as retaining two continuously rotating tube-detector systems.
FDA determination letter for P47, 10 October 2008.
